ON-DEVICE PHOTO SCREENING

Let’s check the details.

Upload a photo to run automatic checks.

Your crop will be checked for framing, background, pose, eyes, expression, lighting, red-eye, and sharpness. Results update when you reposition or zoom.

What these checks can and can’t tell you

These are automated estimates, not passport approval. The 80–85% check estimates vertical head height from the hair or covering boundary to the chin; the supplied guideline does not define an exact measurement method. Head boundaries can be uncertain, especially with coverings or complex hair.

Hair across the eyes, subtle shadows, flash glare, natural skin tones, and the full visibility of facial features cannot be reliably certified. The app does not judge religious or medical exceptions. It preserves your original colors and background. All photo analysis happens on your device using bundled MediaPipe models; your photo is never sent to a server.

Built to the specifications in your supplied guidelines. Automated screening is advisory and can miss problems. Check your application portal for any additional file-size rules. Framing guides and automated checks are approximate; final acceptance is determined by the passport authority. Religious head coverings must leave the face clearly visible.
